e.title: HurricaneGuard (Etherisc)
e.summary: 区块链参数化飓风保险合约（16★，Etherisc）：以太坊智能合约+NOAA 气象参数自动赔付
e.body: HurricaneGuard（etherisc-legacy/HurricaneGuard，16★）是 Etherisc 团队构建的首个区块链参数化飓风保险：以太坊智能合约 + NOAA 验证气象参数，飓风事件触发后数日内自动赔付——覆盖房屋损失、营业损失与收入损失，保单条款公开、合规许可、支持加密货币支付。对 RIAA：参数化保险（[[parametric-insurance]]）的区块链实现案例——智能合约自动执行理赔（与 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 等参数化巨灾债券同思路）；保险科技前沿方向（去中心化保险）；另见 Chainlink 博客的同类作物参数险 demo。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Etherisc 参数化飓风保险智能合约（NOAA 参数触发自动赔付），16★
e.summary_en: Blockchain parametric hurricane insurance contracts (16★, Etherisc): Ethereum smart contracts + NOAA weather parameters with automatic payout
e.summary_hk: 區塊鏈參數化颶風保險合約（16★，Etherisc）：以太坊智能合約+NOAA 氣象參數自動賠付
e.body_en: HurricaneGuard (etherisc-legacy/HurricaneGuard, 16★) is the first blockchain-powered parametric hurricane insurance built by the Etherisc team: Ethereum smart contracts + NOAA-validated weather parameters trigger automatic payouts within days of a hurricane event — covering property damage, business losses and loss of income, with public policy terms, licensed coverage and cryptocurrency payment options. For RIAA: a blockchain implementation case of parametric insurance ([[parametric-insurance]]) — smart contracts automating claim settlement (the same idea as parametric catastrophe bonds such as [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]); an insurtech frontier direction (decentralised insurance); see also the Chainlink-blog crop parametric demo of the same kind.
e.body_hk: HurricaneGuard（etherisc-legacy/HurricaneGuard，16★）是 Etherisc 團隊構建的首個區塊鏈參數化颶風保險：以太坊智能合約 + NOAA 驗證氣象參數，颶風事件觸發後數日內自動賠付——覆蓋房屋損失、營業損失與收入損失，保單條款公開、合規許可、支持加密貨幣支付。對 RIAA：參數化保險（[[parametric-insurance]]）的區塊鏈實現案例——智能合約自動執行理賠（與 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 等參數化巨災債券同思路）；保險科技前沿方向（去中心化保險）；另見 Chainlink 博客的同類作物參數險 demo。
